$comment: Figma references for the Insights Content Themes section. Fetched from the Figma MCP and never regenerated from the browser. Tests refuse to run on a hash mismatch. To refresh: re-fetch, replace the file, update the hash (figma-visual-qa refs.mjs hash) and fetchedAt, and say so in the commit.
fetchedBy: Figma MCP (plugin figma 2.2.157), account seat: View, plan tier: starter

references.note: Reformatted (pretty-printed) from the one-line response; keys and values unchanged.

Response body as returned. Children of BG-pattern carry section-relative coordinates in the response (e.g. Vector x=338 equals its parent's x), so the spec reads the cross boxes as section-relative, not nested.

references.note: Partial agent transcription of the text responses (values used by the spec only).

unavailable.reason: No Arabic frame for the Insights page; only 406:4761 (EN, 1440) exists on 406:836. AR checks are behaviour checks derived from the EN frame (pattern not mirrored, same position).
Every frame on 406:836 is 1440 wide; no tablet/mobile frames. At 768/390 the spec checks the pattern keeps its Figma size and its Figma offset from the section centre (derived), with no overflow.
